image_generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Project asset: ONE fully opaque seamless repeating GRASS ground material for the faithful HD1 remake of a 1995 Taiwanese tactical RPG.
Reference 1 is the USER-APPROVED A style prototype, authoritative ONLY for pixel-handpaint visual language and material palette. Reference 2 is the ORIGINAL gameplay screenshot, authoritative for the corresponding natural material and value balance. Do not copy either scene layout, interface or characters. Output only one square edge-to-edge material swatch.
Material: Dense low mossy OLIVE-GREEN grass carpet with a handful of short readable angular blade clusters. Restrained ochre-green sunlight, moss-green middles and deep forest-green shadows. More grounded muted olive than bright lime. Small broken clusters, not large round leaf bushes or flowers.
Art direction: enhanced hand-painted PIXEL ART, intentional crisp rectangular pixel clusters and stepped contours, a coherent restrained palette, sculpted readable small shapes; preserve the 1995 painted-pixel feel while adding controlled detail. This entire image will be reduced into one 144x144 game tile. Make the artwork look as though painted at roughly 144px logical resolution, with crisp coherent pixel shapes and restrained finer detail. No smooth airbrush, 3D lighting, soft noisy photographic texture or generic bright RPG Maker ground. No blurry brushes or micro-noise. Modest contrast so small chibi characters remain readable.
Technical: square flat orthographic material viewed straight down, uniformly distributed texture, seamless all four edges, no central feature, vignette, edge shadow or empty margin. Upper-left local lighting consistent across whole tile. Fully opaque. No path outline, grass border, cliffs, trees, plants from other material types, objects, horizon, perspective, grid, text, UI, labels, frame, characters or transparency. Just the grass material, without other materials.

segmentation: edge-connected painted green within native-grass zone plus six HD pixels; opaque RGB outside mask unchanged
